literal_meaning: ধনুকাকৃতি যন্ত্র দিয়ে তুলো পিঁজে পরিষ্কার করা
figurative_meaning_en: to scold severely, to reprimand or thrash
similar_in_english: beat the daylights out of someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ তোকে ভালো করে ধুনে দেব।
সে তার ছেলেকে ধুনিয়ে শায়েস্তা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: Today, I'll really give you a good scolding.
She reprimanded her son by giving him a thorough thrashing.
history: The idiom derives from the traditional rural practice of ginning cotton using a bow-shaped tool called a 'dhunka', which involves striking to separate fibers, metaphorically extended to beating or scolding.
note: Rooted in agrarian Bengali life where cotton processing was common.
